fusions.name: Spotter's Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a javelin at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reckoning Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a javelin that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Sentry Post
fusions.desc: Plants a watching shaft that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds, each strike with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
